import sys, random, ctypes
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
from t_common import *
import scamp_pipeline as sp

def mk(path):
    lib = ctypes.CDLL(path)
    lib.find_cuts.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint64),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int32),ctypes.c_int,
        ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int64),ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int32),
        ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int64),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int64),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int64)]
    lib.find_cuts.restype=ctypes.c_int
    lib.lpm_batch.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint64),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint64),
        ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int32),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int32),ctypes.c_int,
        ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint64),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint64),ctypes.c_int,
        ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int32),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int32)]
    lib.lpm_batch.restype=ctypes.c_int
    return lib
A = mk('/app/submit/_scamp_helper.so')
B = mk('/app/tmp/helper_no128.so')

def call(lib, fib, caps, S, ms):
    n=len(fib)
    addrs=(ctypes.c_uint64*(2*max(n,1)))(); lens=(ctypes.c_int32*max(n,1))()
    for i,(a,l,h) in enumerate(fib):
        addrs[2*i]=a>>64; addrs[2*i+1]=a&0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF; lens[i]=l
    c=(ctypes.c_int64*S)(*caps)
    oc=(ctypes.c_int32*(S+1))(); ou=(ctypes.c_int64*S)()
    on=ctypes.c_int64(0); od=ctypes.c_int64(0)
    rc=lib.find_cuts(addrs,lens,n,c,S,ms,oc,ou,ctypes.byref(on),ctypes.byref(od))
    return rc, [int(x) for x in oc], [int(x) for x in ou], on.value, od.value

def lpm(lib, rules, qs):
    nr=len(rules); nq=len(qs)
    rhi=(ctypes.c_uint64*max(nr,1))(); rlo=(ctypes.c_uint64*max(nr,1))()
    rlen=(ctypes.c_int32*max(nr,1))(); rhop=(ctypes.c_int32*max(nr,1))()
    for i,(a,l,h) in enumerate(rules):
        rhi[i]=a>>64; rlo[i]=a&0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF; rlen[i]=l; rhop[i]=h
    qhi=(ctypes.c_uint64*max(nq,1))(); qlo=(ctypes.c_uint64*max(nq,1))()
    for i,a in enumerate(qs): qhi[i]=a>>64; qlo[i]=a&0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    oh=(ctypes.c_int32*max(nq,1))(); ol=(ctypes.c_int32*max(nq,1))()
    rc=lib.lpm_batch(rhi,rlo,rlen,rhop,nr,qhi,qlo,nq,oh,ol)
    assert rc==0
    return [(oh[i],ol[i]) for i in range(nq)]

rng=random.Random(8080)
for t in range(120):
    fib=gen_fib(rng, rng.randint(0,25), rng.choice(['mixed','short','long','aligned']))
    S=rng.randint(4,16); ms=rng.randint(4,32)
    if S*ms<128: continue
    cuts=gen_cuts(rng,S,ms); used=naive_layout_used(fib,cuts)
    caps=[min(10**9,max(1,int(u*rng.choice([0.8,1,1.2,2,7,1000]))+rng.randint(0,2))) for u in used]
    ra=call(A,fib,caps,S,ms); rb=call(B,fib,caps,S,ms)
    assert ra[0]==rb[0] and ra[2:]==rb[2:], (ra,rb,fib,caps,S,ms)
    if ra[0]==0:
        assert Fraction_(ra[3],ra[4])==Fraction_(rb[3],rb[4]) if False else True
        assert naive_layout_used(fib,ra[1])==ra[2]
    # lpm agreement
    qs=[rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(30)]
    la=lpm(A,[(a,l,h) for (a,l,h) in fib],qs); lb=lpm(B,[(a,l,h) for (a,l,h) in fib],qs)
    assert la==lb, (la,lb)
    for q,(h,l) in zip(qs,la):
        best=None
        for (pa,pl,ph) in fib:
            if (q & sp.TMASK[pl])==pa and (best is None or pl>best[1]): best=(ph,pl)
        if best is None: assert (h,l)==(-1,-1), (q,h,l)
        else: assert (h,l)==best, (q,(h,l),best)
print('NO128 vs INT128 + brute LPM: OK')
